camel_example: aliyun dyvmsapi CloudImportTaskTel --region cn-hangzhou --TaskTelList '[{"ClidGroup":"example","Clid":"7766551","Priority":38,"Tel":"7455441","Property":"{}","BackupTels":"7455332"}]' --TaskId 25 --EnterpriseId 17 --Name '批次名称1' --version 2017-05-25 --method POST --force
description_en: Imports phone numbers for an outbound call task
description_zh: 为外呼任务导入任务号码
kebab_example: aliyun dyvmsapi cloud-import-task-tel --enterprise-id 17 --name '批次名称1' --task-id 25 --task-tel-list ClidGroup=example Clid=7766551 Priority=38 Tel=7455441 Property={} BackupTels=7455332 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CloudImportTaskTel

parameters.help_en:
The call center ID.

Before calling this operation, create a call center instance in the Cloud Contact Center console and obtain the instance ID from the instance access URL
parameters.help_zh:
呼叫中心id

调用前需在云联络中心控制台创建呼叫中心实例，并从实例访问地址中获取实例 ID
parameters.name: enterprise_id

parameters.help_en: The batch ID. If this parameter is specified, phone numbers are added to the existing batch
parameters.help_zh: 批次Id；传此值表示在批次中增加号码
parameters.name: file_id

parameters.help_en: The priority. Default value: 0. A larger value indicates a higher priority. Maximum value: 999999
parameters.help_zh: 优先级；默认0，值越大越优先，最大999999
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the deduplication mode. Default value: 1. Valid values:
0: no deduplication.
1: task-level deduplication.
2: imported number deduplication.
3: batch-level deduplication.

Task-level deduplication and batch-level deduplication cannot be used at the same time. If you switch between them, deduplication takes effect starting from the switch
parameters.help_zh:
是否排重，默认为1。
0：不排重
1：任务内排重
2：导入号码排重
3：批次内排重

任务内排重与批次内排重不能同时支持，如果中途切换，则从本次切换开始进行排重
parameters.name: is_repeat

parameters.help_en: The voice variable value from the enterprise voice library. This value specifies the opening voice that is automatically played to both parties when an agent answers the call
parameters.help_zh: 座席接听时自动在双侧播放开场白语音，指定语音变量值；企业语音库里的语音变量值
parameters.name: bridge_voice_path

parameters.help_en:
The type of the opening voice that is automatically played to both parties when an agent answers the call. Default value: 3. Valid values:
1: Public voice library.
2: Enterprise voice library, static script.
3: Enterprise voice library, dynamic script (agent number). Takes effect after bridgeVoicePath is specified
parameters.help_zh:
座席接听时自动在双侧播放开场白语音类型，默认为3。
1：公共语音库；
2：企业语音库，静态话术；
3：企业语音库，动态话术（座席号），传bridgeVoicePath后生效
parameters.name: bridge_voice_type

fields.help_en: The backup phone numbers. If the primary phone number (tel) cannot be reached, the backup numbers are called. A maximum of 8 backup numbers are supported. Separate multiple numbers with commas (,)
fields.help_zh: 备选号码，tel呼叫不通时，呼叫备选号码最多支持8个，号码之间用英文逗号","分隔
fields.name: backup_tels

fields.help_en: The caller ID displayed for the phone number
fields.help_zh: 电话号对应的外显号码
fields.name: clid

fields.help_en: The caller ID group. To use clidGroup, the account must support identifier-based routing. When this parameter is specified, the clid parameter is invalid
fields.help_zh: 使用clidGroup需要账号支持按标识路由，使用此参数是clid参数无效
fields.name: clid_group

fields.help_en: The priority. Default value: 0. A larger value indicates a higher priority. Maximum value: 999999
fields.help_zh: 优先级，默认为0，值越大优先级越高，最大999999
fields.name: priority

parameters.help_en: The list of task phone numbers. In CtiLinkTaskTel, only Tel is required. The maximum size is 8 MB. Note: To obtain import failure details, configure [event push](../字段定义/推送变量和值/预测外呼导入号码失败推送变量.md)
parameters.help_zh: 任务号码列表；CtiLinkTaskTel中只有Tel是必选字段，长度大小不超过8MB 注：获取导入失败明细，需配置[事件推送](../字段定义/推送变量和值/预测外呼导入号码失败推送变量.md)
parameters.name: task_tel_list

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically start the task. Default value: 0. Valid values:
0: Do not automatically start.
1: Automatically start
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动启动任务，默认为0。
0：不自动启动
1：自动启动
parameters.name: import_tel_auto_start

ImportTotal.description_en: The total number of phone numbers in the request

InvalidTotal.description_en: The number of invalid phone numbers

SuccessTotal.description_en: The number of successfully imported phone numbers
